test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth alphanumeric-cluster in the same way as the second alphanumeric-cluster is related to the first alphanumeric-cluster and the fourth alphanumeric-cluster is related to the third alphanumeric-cluster.

WXY72 : ZAB29 :: CDE12 : FGH21 :: IJK30 : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• First, second letter and third letter ⇒ (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number (fourth and fifth position) ⇒ Sum of the position values of the first three letters according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• WXY72 : ZAB29

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de9919bcb9be4293c0e4e63126ffba470574e6cdd61479aafd0aae23144c3221.png] 

And,

 
• CDE12 : FGH21

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b67467fa1f7d59e65bf53e28bca0c95926eff7d5752d6237ad46d53eae8accb4.png] 

Similarly,

 
• IJK30 : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97255f97e640a4e71714dca1f69d776460b352290d196ef407c9aa974e369b38.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**LMN39**".

b8:T
